neighbours.label: an anaphoric 'this' standing alone as the object or subject of a clause ('proved this was', 'will do this'), pointing back at something just described; weaker and unreliable on 'that', 'here' and a repeated topic noun. 'this' as a determiner stays quiet.
fire: Nobody expected the old pump to last, and the first winter proved this was a fair worry.
The guide warned us the path was steep, and the first mile showed this was no exaggeration.
Only a site manager can delete an account directly. Closing a project will do this indirectly.
You may sort the list by hand. The export tool will do this for you.
Critics said the bridge was too narrow, and the opening day proved this was true.
The shop sells a fast pass. If the queue is long, I buy this to skip ahead.
Staff are told to lock the cabinet at night. Most of them do this without thinking.
The teacher asked us to label every jar, and we did this before lunch.
quiet: Nobody expected the old pump to last, and the first winter proved them right.
The guide warned us the path was steep, and the first mile was hard on everyone.
Only a site manager can delete an account directly. Closing a project takes two clicks.
We sorted this list by hand before the export tool existed.
Critics said the bridge was too narrow, and the opening day drew a huge crowd.
The shop sells a fast pass for people who hate long queues.
Staff lock this cabinet at night without thinking.
The teacher asked us to label every jar, and we finished before lunch.

notes: Card: ' this' x8 of the top 32, plus 'here', 'such', 'that' and repeated nouns. Probing was inconsistent: 'proved this was' 0.34-0.55, 'do this directly ... do this implicitly' 0.59, 'help you with that' 0.56, a repeated 'humor' 0.78, but 'most people forget this' 0.04, 'will do this automatically' 0.11 and 'helps with that' 0.03. I do not know what separates the cases, so this is a best guess and may well fail.
